what: A registry dependency's build script is run before its link writes the binary, so every crate with one (zmij, serde_core, serde_json, object 0.39.1) fails: `failed to run custom build command for zmij v1.0.21` / `blaze: could not run <target>/debug/build/zmij/<h>/out/build_script_build: No such file or directory (os error 2)`, and `link: <that path> (first link)` is printed after the failure. The binary exists afterwards (valid arm64 Mach-O, mtime = the end of the job). Deterministic (4 of 4 on blaze b2wt-target/debug/blaze of 19:44, segment fix in). A package's own build script and a path dependency's both run fine, so the gap is the registry script's exec reading a file only written with the job's outputs. This is what self9's #9 (zmij, serde_core) and the serde_json stall (#8) were. Tests: crates/blaze-engine/tests/repro.rs a_registry_dependencys_build_script_runs (zmij alone, prints 1.5) and a_dependency_std_also_uses_builds (object 0.39.1, prints Little).
